site_number: LAND AT SOUTH OF GILLETTE CORNER
description: Variation of condition 13 (Delivery and Servicing Plan) to allow changes to the wording of the condition of planning permission 00505/AF/P29 approved 29/10/2020 for erection of up to six storey building to provide Class B1 (office) and Class B8 (self-storage) uses, with associated car parking and landscaping
site_name: Land At South Of Gillette Corner
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 00505/AF/P28 dated 18/02/2020

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2016-2913-TR05 received 31 August 2021; Transport Note, Covering Letter received 1 July 2021) and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission 00505/AF/P29 (126-RHA-01-01-DR-A-0754 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-02-DR-A-0755 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-03-DR-A-0756 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-04-DR-A-0757 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-05-DR-A-0758 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-GF-DR-A-0750 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-GF-DR-A-0751 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-GF-DR-A-0753 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-RF-DR-A-0759 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-ZZ-DR-A-0752 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-ZZ-DR-A-0760 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-ZZ-DR-A-0765 PL (Rev C); 126-RHA-01-ZZ-DR-A-0770 PL (Rev C); Daylight & Sunlight Report; Design and Access Statement Received: 08 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in materials to match those approved under reference 00505/AF/P29(3)

Condition : 4 - a. The scheme for the removal of the contamination risk identified on the site approved under Confirmation of Details application 00505/AF/P28(4a) shall be implemented and fully adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.
During the course of the development:
b. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local  Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
c. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority as approved under 00505/AF/P28(4ci)

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The building hereby approved shall be used only for offices and storage and for no other purposes (only B1a or B8) without further approval from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the redundant vehicle crossovers from Great West Road, Syon Lane and Northumberland Avenue to the site shall be permanently closed and kerbs and footway reinstated and raised to footway and cycle track.

Condition : 8 - The Construction Logistics Plan approved under Confirmation of Details application 00505/AF/P28(8) on 29 May 2020 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development's construction period.

Condition : 9 - All hard and soft landscaping works shall be undertaken in accordance with Landscape Specification, PJC-0934-001 Rev A, PJC-0934-002 as approved under 00505/AF/P29(9). Any such planting which within a period of five years of implementation of the landscaping dies, is removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of a similar size or species. The approved scheme shall be fully implemented prior to the first use of the building and the maintenance schedule adhered to thereafter.

Condition : 10 - Within three months of the date of this decision, a Car Park Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority that sets out how the site will be managed. The details shall include how on-site spaces are managed efficiently and the designated disabled and EV charging bays are available when necessary and parking is restricted to marked bays only and how the gates to the parking and servicing area would be controlled to prevent vehicles from waiting on the highway to enter the site or from having to reverse onto Northumberland Avenue. The building shall thereafter operate in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 11 - The provision of cycle parking shall be carried out and implemented in accordance with 126-RHA-01-GF-DR-A-0753 Rev F and Oxford Cycle Shelter Specification as approved under 00505/AF/P29(11i).

Condition : 12 - The provision of the electric vehicle charging bays shall be carried out in accordance with 126-RHA-01-GF-DR-A-0771 Rev B, EV Charging Specification as approved under 00505/AF/P29(12).

Condition : 13 - a) Within 3 months of the date of this decision, notwithstanding the submitted information, a Delivery and Servicing Plan (for both uses) shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall accord with current guidance such as that issued by Transport for London and shall show that peak times are avoided for deliveries and servicing. The Plan shall be carried out as approved. The approved measures shall be implemented before the first occupation of the development hereby permitted and shall be so maintained for the life of the development.
b) The Delivery and Servicing Plan dated 1 March 2022 (received 4 March 2022) in relation to the use of articulated vehicles on site shall be adhered to throughout and the lifetime of the development. Articulated vehicles shall only be allowed to access the site between 9:30 ? 14:30 Monday to Friday. No access to articulated vehicles shall be provided outside these times without prior permission of the Local Planning Authority.
c) No more than one articulated vehicle shall visit the site per day without prior permission of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 14 - The Workplace Travel Plan hereby approved shall be adhered and regularly monitored to ensure the measures described in the action plan are implemented.

Condition : 15 - The provision of the external illumination shall be carried out in accordance with 5617 MEP ZZZ 00 DR E 6300 Rev P4, Kingfisher Lighting Datasheet - Quarto and Kingfisher Lighting Datasheet - Viva-City Pro as approved under 00505/AF/P29(15). All illumination within the site shall be retained thereafter in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 16 - Details application 00505/AF/P28(16) on 13 July 2020 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.
b) The development shall be implemented in accordance with the Energy Strategy approved under Confirmation of Details application 00505/AF/P28(16i) on 15 June 2020 and the full Desgin Stage Calculations as approved under Confirmation of Details application 00505/AF/P29(16b) on 11 June 2021
c) The development shall be implemented in accordance with the details approved under application 00505/AF/P28(16c) and the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
d) Upon final commencement of operation of the solar PV panels, suitable devices for the monitoring of the solar PV panels shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring web-platform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.
e) Upon final commencement of operation of the ASHPs, suitable devices for the monitoring of the ASHPs shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring webplatform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 17 - a) The BREEAM New Construction 2014 Shell and Core Design Stage certificate as approved under application 00505/AF/P29(17a) on 6 May 2021 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.
b) The BREEAM New Construction 2014 Assessment Report as approved under application 00505/AF/P29(17b) on 1 August 2022 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.
c) The BREEAM Refurbishment and Fit-out Parts 3 & 4 assessment Design Stage certificate as approved under 00505/AF/P29(17c) on 4 June 2021 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.
d) The BREEAM New Construction 2014 Assessment Report as approved under 00505/AF/P29(17d) on 1 August 2022 shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.

Condition : 18 - The development hereby permitted shall meet the following sustainable materials standards as approved under 00505/AF/P29(18) on 2 August 2022.
a) At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
b) At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
c) No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 19 - The final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations, and updated Drainage Assessment Form, approved under Confirmation of Details application 00505/AF/P28(19) shall be implemented and adhered to throughout the development?s construction period.

Condition : 20 - No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details as approved under 00505/AF/P29(20) on 15 February 2022. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 21 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:
7am until 11pm Monday to Saturday and 10am-6pm Sunday and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 22 - Within 3 months of the date of this decision,, an Operational Site Management Plan shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the details of stored goods within the premises and restriction of food and alcohol storage on-site. The Plan shall be carried out as approved and shall be so maintained for the life of the development.

Condition : 23 - No articulated vehicles shall access the site until, details of the proposed highway works including a Stage 2 Road Safety Audit shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The highway works shall be carried out as approved and completed prior to first occupation, and shall be maintained thereafter for the life of the development.
